_source: Tourism circuits, region highlights and gateway airports. Editorial reference data, kept as a file rather than in the database because it changes with how the industry talks about the country, not with what any one operator sells.

north.name: Northern circuit
north.season: June to October for the dry season; late January to February for calving in the southern Serengeti.
north.blurb: The classic route: Tarangire, Lake Manyara, Ngorongoro and the Serengeti, with Kilimanjaro at the eastern end.

south.name: Southern circuit
south.season: June to October. Roads and airstrips in Ruaha and Nyerere are at their best from July.
south.blurb: Ruaha, Nyerere (Selous), Mikumi and Udzungwa — bigger, wilder and far quieter than the north.

west.name: Western parks
west.season: July to October for Katavi and for chimp trekking on Lake Tanganyika.
west.blurb: Chimpanzees at Gombe and Mahale, and the remote floodplains of Katavi. Fly-in territory.

lake.name: Lake Victoria zone
lake.season: June to October; the western Serengeti corridor is busiest with the migration in May to July.
lake.blurb: Rubondo Island, the western Serengeti, and the towns and islands of Africa's largest lake.

coast.name: Swahili coast
coast.season: June to October and December to February. Avoid the long rains, March to May.
coast.blurb: Dar es Salaam, Bagamoyo, Saadani, Mafia Island and the Usambara hills behind Tanga.

zanz.name: Zanzibar & Pemba
zanz.season: June to October and December to February; Pemba diving is clearest from October to February.
zanz.blurb: Stone Town, the northern and eastern beaches of Unguja, and the reefs and forests of Pemba.

central.name: Central highlands
central.season: Year-round; the rock-art sites are easiest to reach in the dry season, June to October.
central.blurb: The capital, Kondoa rock art and the granite country between the northern and southern circuits.

highlights: Ngorongoro Conservation Area and the Crater
Arusha National Park and Mount Meru
Lake Natron and Ol Doinyo Lengai
Arusha.gateway: Kilimanjaro International (JRO); Arusha Airport (ARK) for light aircraft
Arusha.note: Safari capital of the north — most itineraries start and end here.

Kilimanjaro.note: Climbing seasons: January to March and June to October.

Manyara.gateway: JRO; Lake Manyara and Kuro airstrips
Manyara.note: Tarangire is best for elephants in the dry season.

highlights: Serengeti (north) and the Mara River crossings
Mara.note: River crossings usually July to October.

Simiyu.note: Migration passes through May to July.

Mwanza.note: Main gateway for the western Serengeti.

Geita.note: Rubondo: forest, chimps, fishing and birds.

Kagera.note: Newest national parks, still little visited.

highlights: Transit between Mwanza and the western parks

Kigoma.note: Chimp trekking best July to October.

highlights: Lake Katavi and the Katuma floodplain
Katavi.gateway: Mpanda (NPY) and the Ikuu airstrip, charters from Arusha
Katavi.note: Hippos and buffalo herds; very few visitors.

Tabora.note: History of the Arab caravan route.

Iringa.note: Ruaha: lions, wild dogs, kudu; June to October.

Morogoro.gateway: Dar es Salaam (DAR) by road; Mikumi airstrip
Morogoro.note: Mikumi is the easiest park to reach from Dar.

highlights: Kitulo National Park — the "Garden of God"
Njombe.note: Orchids and wildflowers December to April.

Mbeya.note: Highland base for the far south.

Ruvuma.note: Quiet lake beaches, road access from Mbeya.

Lindi.note: Medieval Swahili ruins on the coast.

highlights: City markets, National Museum, Kivukoni fish market
Dar es Salaam.note: Main international gateway for the south and coast.

Pwani.note: Whale sharks off Mafia, October to March.

highlights: Amani Nature Reserve and the Usambaras
Tanga.note: Hill walking and old Swahili coast.

Dodoma.note: On the road between Arusha and Iringa.

Singida.gateway: By road from Dodoma or Arusha

Mjini Magharibi.note: Arrival point and cultural heart of Zanzibar.

Kaskazini Unguja.note: Best swimming beaches — small tidal range.

Kusini Unguja.note: Kitesurfing at Paje, June to September and December to February.

Kusini Pemba.note: Some of East Africa's best drift diving.
